notes: «وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ» is passive with no named transmitter before «عن»: the gap is an unnamed link (rule 8); the chain's named first link is حارث
«أنه سئل أبو عبد الله» names the Imam in the words after the chain: imam_in_text; the asker is not named in the text, so no asker link
«بياع الأنماط» is part of the name as written
